caption:
Iran spends less on its military today than it did in 1976.

Watch the gap widen: by 2025 Israel's budget reaches $43.7B against Iran's $7.5B — almost six times more. Iran's own peak came half a century ago, at $10.6B in 1976, three years before the Islamic Revolution.

📊 See military spending in Iran and Israel from 1960 to 2025 in this animated chart, in billion USD at constant 2024 prices. Explore how the Six-Day War, the Iran-Iraq War and the war in Gaza shaped two defence budgets over 65 years.
